title: From robot footage to automatic issues
sentences: Fieldlink analyzes robot captured footage, flags candidate problems, and creates highlighted issues linked to a building information model.
This demonstration uses real factory videos, local computer vision models, and representative BIM locations.

title: 01 / Detection → segmentation → issue
sentences: The system samples the recordings automatically. The current check looks for possible dark cables near the floor.
Object detection locates the item, segmentation generates its outline, and the matching check creates an issue. No reviewer needs to draw a box or create the issue.

title: Automatic evidence creation / actual model outputs
sentences: Here is the original frame sampled from the robot's video.
Grounding DINO automatically detects the cable and returns this bounding box.
SAM generates the segmentation mask, highlighting the cable itself.
The system creates the issue with both highlights and its source evidence attached. It is already waiting for review.

title: 02 / Open an issue that already has its evidence
sentences: This issue was created automatically. The detection box and segmentation mask already identify the cable in the original frame.
We can switch between the original and highlighted views. The model score measures detection strength, not the probability of a hazard.

title: 03 / Connect the finding to project context
sentences: The issue keeps its source clip and timestamp, alongside a linked location in the model.
For this demo, clip locations are representative assignments. A project deployment needs registered camera locations and the actual BIM.

title: 04 / Review the finding, not create it
sentences: The reviewer now checks an existing finding. They can confirm it, dismiss a false positive, or optionally correct the highlight.
Here, we confirm the visible cable and record that access requirements still need checking. The original automated detection remains traceable.

title: 05 / Assign the follow-up action
sentences: After confirming the issue, we assign a responsible team and due date.
Resolution still requires follow up evidence, and closure requires verification. Automatic detection does not establish that corrective work is complete.

title: 06 / Share the issue and its evidence
sentences: The handoff includes the PDF punch list, a B C F issue archive, the I F C model, and a source manifest.
Automatic findings and reviewed issues keep their distinct statuses. B C F schemas are validated; independent BIM application import remains pending.

title: 07 / Preserve the original and the generated highlight
sentences: The report includes the generated highlight, source timestamp, model reference, and review history.
The original image is preserved separately. Model identifiers and scores explain how the system produced the finding.

title: The next step: validated construction monitoring
sentences: For a construction deployment, expand and validate the checks on project footage, then connect them to actual BIM and schedule data.
Repeat captures and agreed completion rules can support progress reporting. This demo automates candidate issue detection, highlighting, and creation; it does not measure construction completion.
